player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between the Media room, Exercise room, and Playroom, repeatedly visiting the same rooms without exploring new ones. I incorrectly assumed that returning to the Media room meant I had visited everything, ignoring that the Playroom still had an unvisited direction (east). Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and directions. When I encounter a room I have already visited, I will immediately check if any of its available directions have not yet been taken. If a new direction exists, I will take it immediately rather than returning to a previously visited room. Only when all available directions from all visited rooms have been exhausted will I issue "DONE".
